problem: E32 closed the Cross-Domain/Experience-Layer-enhancement stage, but no minimal input model or measurable target set existed yet for the next real focus: evolving the PROJECT itself using Experience, rather than continuing to enhance the Experience Layer.

decision.decision_summary: Built the Evolution input model by reading only existing real artifacts (Goal/Capability/Gap/Priority/Experience/Pattern/Principle/Currency). Defined 5 measurable Evolution axes, all backed by real data. Applied the judgment rules (Experience=grounds, Currency=freshness, PB state=now) to the strongest real finding: trace v15's goal_ghibli_production_pipeline chain is stale relative to 2 independent already-current real artifacts. Generated exactly 1 real Evolution Candidate (cand_evolution_trace_v15_ghibli_status_staleness_v1), not applied.

action.action_summary: Read-only aggregation across overlay v1-v6, trace v1-v15, development-priority-v1, Pattern Registry, Principle Registry, Currency readiness manifest, and the full canonical Experience set. 0 files modified.

result.note: Establishes the Project Evolution input model and target set; does not modify any Goal/Capability/Gap/Priority data, does not change this Goal's own real status.

cause.root_cause_summary: Every real self-improvement mechanism built E1..E32 targeted PB's own tooling; only 1 real Experience (PHASE-959) ever changed the actual project's Goal/Capability state -- the infrastructure for driving further real project evolution via Experience did not yet exist.

lesson: Reading existing real artifacts together, rather than in isolation, surfaced a genuine 3-way corroborated staleness (Experience + overlay agree, trace + development-priority do not) that no single-artifact check across the whole E1..E32 arc had ever surfaced -- because none of those phases cross-referenced Gap-tracking data against Capability-tracking data for the same real chain.
